answer: Proposed service gate: reserve one attested module per ID/day to screen onyx for cracks and meadow or grove images for blight. Validators check exclusive serial registration, code attestation and fresh test results; failure delists. Ten IDs need ten modules despite pooled hosts or parallel jobs. Modules are reusable capital; power recurs; no stake. The bound assumes unclonable keys and honest vendors; tests do not prove uptime or unique owners. At an assumed rental of 1 token/module-day, ten IDs cost 10 tokens/day; owned idle modules have lower marginal cost.
